title: Yeast-infused Smoky Tunisian Mackerel Tagine
description: A deeply aromatic, smoky fish tagine featuring crisp mackerel fillets simmered with bhuna spices, unwaxed lime, and a savory pinch of nutritional yeast for an earthy depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: bhuna spice paste
ingredients.notes: concentrated ginger, garlic, cumin, and cardamom blend

instructions: Pat the mackerel fillets dry with paper towels and season the skin side with salt and half of the smoked paprika.
Heat one tablespoon of olive oil in a heavy tagine or deep cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the mackerel fillets skin-side down for three minutes until the skin is golden and very crisp, then transfer them to a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium, add the remaining olive oil, and saute the chopped onion until soft and translucent.
Stir in the bhuna spice paste, the remaining smoked paprika, and the nutritional yeast, cooking for two minutes until highly fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer for five minutes to reduce and thicken the sauce.
Nestle the seared mackerel fillets back into the sauce skin-side up, then scatter the unwaxed lime slices around them.
Cover the tagine and cook on low heat for six minutes until the fish is just cooked through and flakey.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot directly from the pot.
